scope: Independent visual review of four actual PNGs, including byte-identical V5 native regeneration.
checks: Legible labels, legends, units, point markers and six native panels.
Weak-hit axes and labels distinguish both initializations and the actual observed weak-rain interval.
Map labels OA and XA groups; gallery caption specifies X-to-A for the 33/30 false-alarm counts and marks arrows as neighbor pairs.
QRAIN panel distinguishes individual values and paired-difference median, and shows zero on symlog axis.
Native panel identifies fixed model levels, L, E, component decomposition, and QR sediment versus QV/TK condensation; caption excludes vertical integration and adding components twice.
limits: Visual review does not itself establish scientific or runtime validity.
v5_native_reproduction: PNG byte-identical to reviewed image; metadata and receipt refreshed.
